Engineering

Engineering comes first.

Addison is a Mechanical Engineering student at UW Tacoma, currently a junior, with expected graduation in June 2029. He is based in Tacoma, WA.

He is a member of the SAME rocket build team at UW Tacoma, on the Structures team, where students design, build, and test a rocket together as a team.

His full engineering portfolio covers the team work and his coursework in one place.

Copywriting

Felizola Copywriting.

Under Felizola Copywriting, Addison writes Klaviyo email copy for Shopify DTC brands, the flows that turn one-time buyers into repeat customers.

The starting point is the Five-Leak Audit, a check of where a store email setup is losing sales. The work is grounded in research: 66 brands studied before writing a word for a client.
